correctness.rationale: The cap-size argument proves three-colour minimality. Exact inclusion-exclusion over 4,096 subsets gives all polynomial coefficients. Independent line constructions and full finite-state enumerations by Python and C++ reproduce 3,762 states, 16,848 edges, five full affine/palette orbits, and all 3,762 BFS distance profiles. The exceptional 144+162 orbit classes have eccentricity ten and exactly two antipodes per state; no non-finite generalization is asserted.

value.rationale: The smallest ternary affine-plane line system gives a natural, canonical optimum hypergraph-colouring reconfiguration test. The 306 peripheral states are exactly two intrinsic geometry types (singleton class or parallel rainbow lines); all other 3,456 states are central with eccentricity nine. This classification is stronger than routine colourability, enumeration or relabeling and supplies a sharp metric boundary at the palette minimum.
